name: hbfd_rly_136_we

job.purpose: HBM R25GQ die relay family: hbfd_rly_136_WE, one register stage of width class 136 b (in W / out E, ck + rs S), 21.6 x 21.6 um, M5 cap, pins at 2 tracks on one layer a face, flops at the pins, minimum output delay at the pin (outhold); replaces the generated per-instance relay station placeholders of its class (tools/hbm_die_rly_kits.py --map)

structural_change: HBM-NATIVE5/RLY4 hp1 (2026-10-18): output stage re-kit. Closed hbfd_rly_136_we-v1-2d0c1a8ac (kit predates the recipe-2 pin defaults: implicit HB4xp67 pad on every pin) fails native launch 221.6 ps > 220 on 3 o pins (worst o[16]; owners HBM native audit), still FAIL relative to every GEN1 neighbour view it drives (native_pin_audit --relative-to the same master / _fc / _fc_f2 / _fc_f4: 221.6-241.1 ps). Kit re-generated with the current recipe-2 pin defaults (hold_pad HB2xp67 instead of the implicit HB4xp67 output/input pad, pin_reg_split = one dedicated launch flop per o pin FIRM at the o face, OT_KEEP_PIN_REGS=1); outline 21.6 x 21.6, pin faces and pin plan unchanged; 0 data cycles. RTL of this master unchanged (the shared sources hbfd_rly_masters.sv / ot_hbm_rly.sv changed for the NS/SN masters only); rs capture is not near the limit (worst capture is i[*] 163-165 ps), so no RS_RELAY.

reroute_reason.fix: kit re-generated with the recipe-2 output stage: hold_pad HB2xp67 (was implicit HB4xp67 on every o pin: lead BUF + HB4 + BUF ~ +120 ps TT per the recipe-2 note), pin_reg_split one launch flop per o pin FIRM at the o face (io_flop_at_pins), OT_KEEP_PIN_REGS=1; same outline / pin faces
